item.description: League leaders Bromley cemented their credentials as title challengers with a dominant 4-1 victory over Kent rivals Gillingham. item.title: Sky Bet League One Round Up: Lincoln close gap to Cardiff with win
item.description: Lincoln City closed the gap to league leaders Cardiff City with a 1-0 win over Wigan Athletic. Jack Moylan's fourth goal in three games gave the Imps victory, whilst Cardiff were held to a 2-2 draw in a thriller against Burton Albion. The gap at the top of the table is now just two points, whilst Lincoln have opened up a six-point gap to Bolton Wanderers in third.
